sender.en: An online “investment”, trading or franchise group on Facebook, Telegram or a website

name.en: Unregistered investment: “guaranteed 12% in 5 days” and referral bonuses

how.en: An online group or platform invites you to invest from a few hundred pesos in crypto trading, food carts or a “co-ownership” business. It promises guaranteed returns in days or weeks and pays commissions when you bring in friends. Early payouts are made from new investors’ money. The SEC has ordered such schemes to stop because they are unregistered securities and investment fraud.

text.en: An online page or group offers an investment with small minimum amounts.
It promises guaranteed high returns in days or weeks.
You earn commissions for recruiting friends and family.
You are pushed to invest more or reinvest before the slots close.
You send money to the group’s account or app.
Start with only P500! Our AI crypto platform gives a GUARANTEED 20% profit every 7 days, plus 5% for every friend you invite. Limited slots this week, PM us now to join.

en: investment promised guaranteed returns in days
online platform pays commission for inviting friends
crypto trading group guaranteed profit every week
food business co-ownership with passive income promise
No SEC licence to sell investments.
Check with the SEC that the company and the investment are registered and licensed before you pay.
Don’t recruit friends or family into it.
If you already invested, keep your receipts and chats and report it to the SEC and the PNP-ACG.

sources.title: SEC flags unlicensed investment, crypto trading scheme
